title: the-ruled-cadence-moves-down-to-the-liveness-tool
intention: The ruled heartbeat cadence (CADENCE_S = 60.0, Akien 2026-08-22) is defined once in the liveness tool beside the staleness threshold it sets; the ground loop and the launchers' proof read it there, so nothing reaches into the cairn device to learn how often the heart beats.
why: RULE 1 (Akien, 2026-10-01): a device's public interface is the bus plus its published client tools, and the ground loop is a machine inside the cairn device. launchers/proofs/test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller.py:59 imports CADENCE_S from the ground loop's __main__ — one of the 80 encapsulation_breaches measured 2026-10-05, and the first site the peer's standing order names. The liveness tool already defines staleness as five ticks at that cadence, so the ruled number belongs beside it.
traces_to: RULE 1 (encapsulation, Akien 2026-10-01); ticket 8e3474a6ae43 falsifier clause (3), zero encapsulation_breaches; Law 1 (one ruled number, one definition site)
how: cairn/tools/liveness/liveness.py gains CADENCE_S = 60.0 and STALENESS_THRESHOLD_S becomes 5 * CADENCE_S; cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/__main__.py imports CADENCE_S from the tool instead of defining it; launchers/proofs/test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller.py imports it from the tool. One new proof.
falsifier: GREEN when (1) cairn.tools.liveness.liveness.CADENCE_S == 60.0 and STALENESS_THRESHOLD_S == 5 * CADENCE_S; (2) cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/__main__.py assigns no top-level CADENCE_S, imports it from cairn.tools.liveness.liveness, and main()'s default cadence is that name; (3) encapsulation_breaches carries no row on module cairn.devices.cairn.machines.ground_loop.__main__. RED if any fails or cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/proofs/test_stop_is_prompt.py goes red. WRONG INTENT if the cadence turns out to be the loop's private tuning rather than a system-wide ruled number other components legitimately need.
workflow_and_state: code-seam@v2: THINKME -> TICKETME -> BUILDME -> PROVEME -> PROVED -> [SUPERSEDED]
watchme: none, because the build_inspector's encapsulation_breaches sieve (cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py) already reds any new reach into the ground loop's __main__ on every inspection
children: none, because the change is one constant moved and two imports rewired across cairn/tools/liveness/liveness.py, cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/__main__.py and launchers/proofs/test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller.py, plus one new proof

decisions.text: D1: SETTLED: in cairn/tools/liveness/liveness.py, directly above the comment block '# THE STALENESS THRESHOLD — RULED by Akien 2026-07-31', add `CADENCE_S = 60.0` preceded by the comment lines '# THE CADENCE — RULED by Akien 2026-08-22: the ground loop beats once per minute.' and '# This is the ONE class-space definition site; the ground loop and every proof that needs' and '# the beat interval import it from here (RULE 1: nothing reaches into the cairn device for it).' Then change `STALENESS_THRESHOLD_S = 300.0` to `STALENESS_THRESHOLD_S = 5 * CADENCE_S` (still 300.0: five missed ticks, as the existing comment already says).

D2: SETTLED: in cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/__main__.py, delete line 47 `CADENCE_S = 60.0  # the ruled cadence: once per minute (Akien, 2026-08-22)` and change line 44 `from cairn.tools.liveness.liveness import read_liveness, write_liveness` to `from cairn.tools.liveness.liveness import CADENCE_S, read_liveness, write_liveness`. main()'s signature `cadence: float = CADENCE_S` is unchanged. CADENCE_S stays importable from __main__, so cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/proofs/test_stop_is_prompt.py (same component) needs no edit.

D3: SETTLED: in launchers/proofs/test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller.py, change line 59 `from cairn.devices.cairn.machines.ground_loop.__main__ import CADENCE_S as _CADENCE_S  # noqa: E402` to `from cairn.tools.liveness.liveness import CADENCE_S as _CADENCE_S  # noqa: E402`. Nothing else in that file changes.

D4: SETTLED: new proof cairn/tools/liveness/proofs/test_the_ruled_cadence_is_the_tools.py, shaped like cairn/tools/liveness/proofs/test_liveness_is_a_tool.py (_REPO_ROOT = parents[4] on sys.path; PROOF_TIMEOUT_S = 900; a `_Late` class resolving cairn.tools.liveness.liveness and cairn.machines.build_inspector.inspector at call time; `_tooth` printing '  green <name>' or '  RED   <name>: ...'; then 'N passed, M failed out of T', exit 1 on any fail). PROVES = {"48c0c58a1714": {"1": "the_tool_defines_the_ruled_cadence", "2": "the_ground_loop_reads_the_tools_cadence", "3": "nothing_reaches_into_the_ground_loop_for_its_cadence"}}. Tooth 1: liveness.CADENCE_S == 60.0 and liveness.STALENESS_THRESHOLD_S == 5 * liveness.CADENCE_S. Tooth 2: ast.parse of cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/__main__.py finds no top-level Assign/AnnAssign to CADENCE_S, a top-level ImportFrom of cairn.tools.liveness.liveness naming CADENCE_S (no alias), and main()'s `cadence` default is ast.Name 'CADENCE_S'. Tooth 3: no row of inspector.encapsulation_breaches(repo root) has module 'cairn.devices.cairn.machines.ground_loop.__main__'.

D5: SETTLED: write cairn/tools/liveness/proofs/test_the_ruled_cadence_is_the_tools.py first and run it at HEAD: all three teeth red (measured 2026-10-05: no CADENCE_S in the tool; __main__ defines it at line 47; one breach at launchers/proofs/test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller.py:59). Run cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/proofs/test_stop_is_prompt.py before the build and record its exit. Then make D1-D3, run cairn/tools/liveness/proofs/test_the_ruled_cadence_is_the_tools.py (exit 0, 3/3) and cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/proofs/test_stop_is_prompt.py (exit as before); launchers/proofs/test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller.py is a long live-launch proof and is run once after the build to confirm it still imports and exits as before. Commit cairn/tools/liveness/liveness.py, cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/__main__.py, launchers/proofs/test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller.py and cairn/tools/liveness/proofs/test_the_ruled_cadence_is_the_tools.py together naming 48c0c58a1714, letting the pre-commit reseal door reseal.

D6: SETTLED (measured 2026-10-05 for D1): cairn/tools/liveness/liveness.py lines 40-46 read exactly: '# THE STALENESS THRESHOLD — RULED by Akien 2026-07-31 (recorded on the ticket):' / '# five missed ticks at the ruled cadence. Three-times-the-interval is the' / '# standard heuristic; five gives slack for a loaded box. This is the ONE' / '# class-space definition site; consumers read the verdict, not this.' / '# Cadence moved from 1.0s to 60.0s (Akien, 2026-08-22).' / 'STALENESS_THRESHOLD_S = 300.0'. D1's three comment lines and CADENCE_S = 60.0 go immediately above line 40, followed by one blank line.

D7: SETTLED (governs D4): the proof cairn/tools/liveness/proofs/test_the_ruled_cadence_is_the_tools.py already stands on disk, written first as this ticket's red-first step and measured red 3/3 at HEAD (2026-10-05); it is committed at the BUILDME crossing.
